title: Admin MFA Reset Request
description: POST /api/v1/admin/users/{user_id}/mfa/reset body. Platform-admin only, human JWT only. The reason is recorded in the audit event. The acting admin's own second factor (`code`, or the `X-MFA-Code` header) is required: without it the call answers 400 MFA_STEP_UP_REQUIRED.

reason.description: Why the second factor is being reset (for example a lost device and recovery codes). Stored in the audit trail.

code.description: The ACTING admin's current TOTP code or an unused recovery code (step-up). Alternative to the `X-MFA-Code` header; if both are given they must be identical. Never logged or echoed.
